title.en: Where existing protection should be examined next, and one test of it.
title.zh: 已有的保护下一步该在哪里检验，以及一项已完成的检验。

lead.en: Candidate questions checked against the closest existing work (searches on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25), and one condition-transfer experiment.
lead.zh: 把候选问题与最接近的已有工作对照（检索于 2026-10-24、10-25），并完成一项条件迁移实验。

title.en: No reviewed work follows memory authority from cross-session consolidation through a hand-off to execution.
title.zh: 在核查的工作中，没有一项把记忆权威从跨会话整合、经过转交、一直跟到执行。

title.en: Which links the 19 closest works cover
title.zh: 最接近的 19 篇工作覆盖了哪些环节

items.en: Constrained memory → consolidation across sessions → delegation to another agent → tool execution.
items.zh: 带约束的记忆 → 跨会话整合 → 委托给另一个 Agent → 工具执行。

items.en: Constraint kept, lost, or attacked; a no-attacker control; same or later session; same agent or sub-agent; token or effect binding.
items.zh: 约束保留、丢失或受攻击；无攻击者对照；同一或之后的会话；同一 Agent 或子 Agent；绑定令牌或具体效果。

items.en: Execution beyond the original task, object or operation; authorised use kept; false refusals; where the constraint is lost.
items.zh: 超出原任务、对象或操作的执行；已授权使用的保留；误拒；约束在哪个环节丢失。

title.en: Retrieval protection carried over to the final record: 73 of 90 records endorsed the attacker's answer without a defence, 4 with TrustRAG.
title.zh: 检索保护延续到了最终记录：无防御时 90 条记录中 73 条认可攻击者答案，TrustRAG 下为 4 条。

items.zh: 逐题配对差异，TrustRAG − 无防御（95% 区间 −85.6 至 −67.8）

items.zh: （共 90）个干净任务需要补救提示（无防御 → TrustRAG）

items.zh: 任何设置下都没有越权执行：授权边界仍未得到检验

p.en: Setting: 90 PoisonedRAG NQ questions not used in development; one local model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) and the same knowledge-tool interface in every setting; no defence, the full TrustRAG pipeline, and its k-means filter alone; measured at the tool answer and at the final record of the same flow. Labels are semantic judgements, model-assisted and adjudicated; uncertain labels stay apart and give a range, not a confidence interval. On the 81 questions whose target answer is invalid the result is 64/81 against 2/81. TrustRAG and the filter alone reach the same count but share only two of the four questions.
p.zh: 设置：90 道未参与开发的 PoisonedRAG NQ 题；所有设置用同一个本地模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和同一个知识工具接口；无防御、完整 TrustRAG、只用其 k-means 过滤；在同一流程的工具回答和最终记录两处测量。标签为语义判定，模型辅助并经裁定；含糊标签单列，给出范围，不是置信区间。在目标答案无效的 81 题上，结果为 64/81 对 2/81。TrustRAG 与仅过滤计数相同，但四题中只有两题共同。
